name: handheld-low
input_contract: Player-provided ARM64/Mali-ready STS2 Godot 4.5.1 PCK and matching unmodified ARM64 game DLL/deps; this tool does not convert a Windows distribution to ARM64.
texture: Halve physical image dimensions, retaining logical size, flags and texture format; preserve font, normal, LUT, HDR/data and other protected semantic assets.
spine: Spine fork source jenny92-tech/spine-runtimes 4.2 revision 7c1c1682bf703ac3204dc8bba4bc178109fc31c8 (CI run 26935186871) uses Texture.get_width/get_height for UV; the installed binary has not independently been bound to that CI hash. Spine candidates are included only for this source PCK identity, with logical dimensions retained.
memory: Explicit low mode keeps essential atlases and loads other supported atlases on demand.
effects: Apply audited simple scenes and scan all text resources for ParticleProcessMaterial turbulence and recognized canvas shader feature patterns. Preserve node and shader interfaces; visual pixels can change. Report unhandled VisualShader, binary and dynamic resources. Preload only approved light scenes without instantiating their typed roots.
delivery: The verified main PCK remains on SD, separate from the small compatibility PCK and /tmp execution view. Install checks full hashes; startup checks identity, size and modification time.
measurements: Encoded file savings are not RSS, GPU allocation, or measured gameplay performance.
